text: あかいやねで　Ｐ．Ｃと　かかれた　たてものが　ポケモンセンターです。

structure.jp: Ｐ．Ｃと　かかれた　たてものが
structure.en: the building with "P.C" written on it

structure.jp: ポケモンセンターです。

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: かく becomes かかれる to say the thing has it done to it: 'is written' rather than 'writes'. かかれた = 'was written'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と after words shows exactly what is said or written, like quotation marks. Ｐ．Ｃと = '(written) as "P.C"'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: Ｐ．Ｃと　かかれた　たてもの
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. Ｐ．Ｃと　かかれた　たてもの = 'the building with "P.C" written on it'.
